1.24.4.title: What's new in v1.24.4
bullets: The acquisition log's read model is now correct — it was treated as a ring buffer, but the game actually keeps a shifting list. That underlying mistake was the real cause of the log repeatedly stalling on stale entries.
New entries are now read straight from the end of the list, so the log keeps up across game restarts, session recovery and long idle periods.

1.24.3.title: What's new in v1.24.3
bullets: The acquisition log no longer assumes a fixed 2000-slot ring — it measures the real size and re-maps itself, so long sessions keep showing the newest entries.
The first batch after launch is checked for skew too: stale content is detected and the reader re-anchors to the true newest record instead of showing hours-old entries.

1.24.2.title: What's new in v1.24.2
bullets: Act boss chest counts stay correct across game restarts — session boundaries now use the game's own session anchor instead of a save-time gap.
The acquisition log keeps up during long idle sessions: the reader scans the ring for the true newest entry and re-anchors itself instead of stalling on stale content.

1.24.1.title: What's new in v1.24.1
bullets: Act boss chest counts no longer include ghost entries left over from an earlier game session — v1.2.4 never restores them in game.
Those leftovers also stop creating auto-open queue entries that never counted down; the Chests tab shows how many were excluded.

1.24.0.title: What's new in v1.24.0
bullets: Game v1.2.4 is supported — live gold, stage and wave tracking no longer fall back to 5-second save polling after the update.
Gold rollbacks are fixed: live readings that stay below your saved balance are flagged and replaced, and hero levels no longer collapse to 1.
Chest drop rates no longer double-count — session rates were up to 2x too high, and the rolling hourly rate is now protected against opening bursts.
New Wish / Craft / Reforge categories in the Record log filters.

1.23.0.title: What's new in v1.23.0
bullets: New Record panel at the bottom of Live — a faithful mirror of the in-game acquisition log, archived across sessions with paging.
Missed box-open results are backfilled so Loot counts match what you actually opened; fixed the first box going unrecorded when opening several at once.
Normal and Plague map chest rates now use their own map time, so mixing maps no longer dilutes either rate.
New In-hand column in Inventory — instant-sell totals deduct Steam and publisher fees per order-book level.

1.17.0.title: What's new in v1.17.0
bullets: Box detail panels in Lookup show per-stage spawn chances, full loot tables, and First clear labels.
Material pages now list every recipe that uses them in a Used in crafting section.
Item names in Inventory are now links — click to jump to the item's detail in Lookup.
Drop chances and pool percentages corrected to match game data (v1.00.21).

1.16.0.title: What's new in v1.16.0
bullets: New Lookup tab — browse 1,500+ items, boxes, and stages with search, filters, and sort.
Every item shows stats plus Where to find: boss drops, crafting, synthesis, and Cube Offering coins.
Open Offering coins to see full Cube loot tables; open boxes and stages for drop lists.
Inventory filters for grade, item type, and location are now multi-select.

1.15.0.title: What's new in v1.15.0
bullets: Inventory instant sell totals now use the full buy-order book, with a badge when depth runs out.
Market value and Instant total summary cards follow your active filters.
Unequipped only filter and the Equipped column make mixed equip/stash rows easier to read.
Optional Instant avg column in the column picker.

1.13.0.title: What's new in v1.13.0
bullets: New Discord button on About for community help and release chatter.
What's New appears once after updates when a release includes bundled notes.
